headline: Skyworks advertises circuit-simulator agents and RAG evaluation for analog/RF design
fact: Skyworks posted San Jose co-op 78610 within the Mobile Solutions Division Software Engineering group. It assigns LLM agents connected to circuit simulators such as Spectre/Virtuoso and ADS, RAG over design documents and PDKs, and agent-performance evaluation on LNAs, PAs, switches and bias circuits in Si/SOI processes. The project includes schematic and simulation automation alongside layout tasks. January-June 2027 is the advertised work term. This analog/RF circuit-design research mandate is distinct from the earlier mixed-signal verification-platform co-op; neither posting demonstrates completed deployment.
